+'
+	return $?
+}
+
+# Decide whether hold-for-review may be lifted. Prints "lift" or "keep\t<why>".
+_verify_runtime_hold_decision() {
+	local pr_number="$1"
+	local repo="$2"
+	local pr_json="$3"
+	local issues="" issue="" state_rc=0 scopes="" scope_rc=0 body=""
+	if ! printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -e --arg l "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL" 'any(.labels[]?; .name == $l)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+		printf 'absent\n'
+		return 0
+	fi
+	scopes=$(_latest_trusted_hold_scope "$pr_number" "$repo") || scope_rc=$?
+	case "$scope_rc" in
+	0) ;;
+	1)
+		printf 'keep\tthe hold scope was never recorded (PR predates GH#39639 or the hold was added by hand); a maintainer removes %s after review\n' "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope could not be read\n'
+		return 0
+		;;
+	esac
+	if [[ "$scopes" != "$_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE" ]]; then
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope is %s, not runtime-pending alone\n' "$scopes"
+		return 0
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#34052 -- a trusted PR-only contract on any linked
+	# issue keeps the hold even when the marker says runtime-pending.
+	issues=$(_merge_linked_issue_numbers "$pr_number" "$repo" "$pr_json") || {
+		printf 'keep\tlinked issues could not be verified\n'
+		return 0
+	}
+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	issues=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$issues" "$(printf '%s' "$body" |
+		grep -oiE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(for|ref)[[:space:]]+#[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' || true)" |
+		grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | sort -u || true)
+	while IFS= read -r issue; do
+		[[ -n "$issue" ]] || continue
+		state_rc=0
+		_issue_pr_only_contract_state "$issue" "$repo" || state_rc=$?
+		case "$state_rc" in
+		0)
+			printf 'keep\tissue #%s has a trusted PR-only completion contract\n' "$issue"
+			return 0
+			;;
+		1) ;;
+		*)
+			printf 'keep\tPR-only scope for issue #%s could not be verified\n' "$issue"
+			return 0
+			;;
+		esac
+	done <<<"$issues"
+	printf 'lift\n'
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_parse_args() {
+	local -a args=("$@")
+	local index=0 arg="" value=""
+	while [[ "$index" -lt "${#args[@]}" ]]; do
+		arg="${args[$index]}"
+		value=""
+		if [[ "$arg" == "--testing" || "$arg" == "--repo" ]]; then
+			if [[ $((index + 1)) -ge ${#args[@]} ]]; then
+				print_error "${arg} requires a value"
+				return 1
+			fi
+			value="${args[$((index + 1))]}"
+		fi
+		case "$arg" in
+		--testing)
+			vr_evidence="$value"
+			index=$((index + 2))
+			;;
+		--repo)
+			vr_repo="$value"
+			index=$((index + 2))
+			;;
+		--dry-run)
+			vr_dry_run=1
+			index=$((index + 1))
+			;;
+		-*)
+			print_error "Unknown verify-runtime option: $arg"
+			_verify_runtime_usage
+			return 1
+			;;
+		*)
+			if [[ -z "$vr_pr" ]]; then
+				vr_pr="$arg"
+			elif [[ -z "$vr_repo" ]]; then
+				vr_repo="$arg"
+			else
+				_verify_runtime_usage
+				return 1
+			fi
+			index=$((index + 1))
+			;;
+		esac
+	done
+	if [[ ! "$vr_pr" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ || -z "$vr_evidence" ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_usage
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Validate the PR, checkout and body before any write. Sets vr_head,
+# vr_new_body, vr_pending_reason and vr_rewrite in the caller's scope.
+_verify_runtime_prepare() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local pr_json="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local login="$4"
+	local state="" cross="" local_head="" body="" metadata="" level="" sections="" risk=""
+	local final_evidence="" new_metadata="" refusal="" parsed_evidence=""
+
+	state=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.state // ""')
+	# tostring, not `// "unknown"`: jq's alternative operator treats false as absent.
+	cross=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.isCrossRepository | tostring')
+	vr_head=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.headRefOid // ""')
+	if [[ "$state" != "OPEN" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is ${state:-unreadable}; verify-runtime only records evidence on an open PR"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$cross" != "false" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head is not in ${repo}; fork heads are verified by re-publishing from a same-repo branch"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- evidence binds to the exact tested head.
+	local_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || local_head=""
+	if [[ ! "$vr_head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$local_head" != "$vr_head" ]]; then
+		print_error "Local HEAD (${local_head:-none}) is not PR #${vr_pr} head (${vr_head:-unknown}); check out the exact PR head, exercise it, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then
+		print_error "The checkout has uncommitted tracked changes, so the exercised tree is not the PR head; stash or commit them, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi
+
+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	metadata=$(printf '%s' "$body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	level=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')
+	sections=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.sections // 0')
+	risk=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')
+	vr_pending_reason=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')
+	if [[ "$sections" != "1" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has ${sections} Runtime Testing sections; verify-runtime needs exactly the one generated section"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	vr_rewrite=1
+	# shellcheck disable=SC2154 # initialized by full-loop-helper-risk.sh
+	case "$level" in
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_pending_marker") ;;
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker")
+		vr_rewrite=0
+		vr_new_body="$body"
+		print_info "PR #${vr_pr} body is already ${_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker}; leaving its evidence unchanged"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is not runtime-pending (verification level: ${level:-none}); nothing to verify"
+		return 1
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	final_evidence="${evidence} (verified at head ${vr_head:0:12} by @${login})"
+	vr_new_body=$(printf '%s' "$body" | VR_EVIDENCE="$final_evidence" _verify_runtime_rewrite_body) || {
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has no single generated runtime-pending Verification line to rewrite"
+		return 1
+	}
+	# Re-parse with the merge-time parser: the rewritten body must be accepted
+	# by the same recheck merge runs, keep its risk, and carry the evidence whole.
+	new_metadata=$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	parsed_evidence=$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')
+	if [[ "$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')" != "$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker" ||
+		"$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')" != "$risk" ||
+		"$parsed_evidence" != "$final_evidence" ]]; then
+		print_error "The rewritten body does not parse back to the supplied evidence; remove markdown headings, bullets or markers from --testing"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! refusal=$(_runtime_testing_merge_refusal "$new_metadata"); then
+		print_error "The rewritten body would still be refused at merge: ${refusal}"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Write the body and verify it landed on the same head. A head that moved
+# during the edit invalidates the evidence: restore the original body.
+_verify_runtime_write_body() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local original_body="$2"
+	local body_file="" after_json="" after_head="" after_level="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	printf '%s\n' "$vr_new_body" >"$body_file"
+	gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?
+	rm -f "$body_file"
+	if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
+		print_error "Could not update PR #${vr_pr} body; nothing else was changed"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	after_json=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --json headRefOid,body) || after_json=""
+	after_head=$(printf '%s' "$after_json" | jq -r '.headRefOid // ""' 2>/dev/null) || after_head=""
+	after_level=$(printf '%s' "$after_json" | jq -r '.body // ""' 2>/dev/null |
+		_runtime_testing_metadata_from_body | jq -r '.level // ""' 2>/dev/null) || after_level=""
+	if [[ "$after_head" != "$vr_head" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head moved during verification (${vr_head:0:12} -> ${after_head:-unknown}); restoring the runtime-pending body"
+		body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+		printf '%s\n' "$original_body" >"$body_file"
+		gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null ||
+			print_error "Restore failed: PR #${vr_pr} body claims evidence for a superseded head; set its Verification line back to runtime-pending"
+		rm -f "$body_file"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$after_level" != "$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body did not reach the ${_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker} postcondition; rerun verify-runtime"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_lift_hold() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local labels=""
+	if ! gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --remove-label "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL" >/dev/null; then
+		print_error "Could not remove ${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} from PR #${vr_pr}; the body is verified, so rerunning verify-runtime retries the label only"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	labels=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --json labels --jq '[.labels[].name] | join(",")') || labels="unreadable"
+	if [[ ",${labels}," == *",${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL},"* || "$labels" == "unreadable" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} did not reach the label-removed postcondition; rerun verify-runtime"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_audit_comment() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local login="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local hold_line="$4"
+	local body_file="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	cat >"$body_file" <<EOF
+<!-- ops:start — workers: skip this comment, it is audit trail not implementation context -->
+<!-- aidevops:verify-runtime head=${vr_head} -->
+**Runtime verified** by @${login} at head \`${vr_head}\` (\`full-loop-helper.sh verify-runtime\`, GH#39639).
+
+- Evidence: ${evidence}
+- Previous runtime-pending reason: ${vr_pending_reason:-not recorded}
+- Hold: ${hold_line}
+<!-- ops:end -->
+EOF
+	gh_pr_comment "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?
+	rm -f "$body_file"
+	return "$rc"
+}
+
+# verify-runtime <PR> [REPO] --testing "<evidence>" [--repo R] [--dry-run]
+# Exit 0 on recorded evidence (VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=lifted|kept|absent on
+# stdout); 1 on refusal or failed write. Every refusal precedes every write.
+cmd_verify_runtime() {
+	local vr_pr="" vr_repo="" vr_evidence="" vr_dry_run=0
+	local vr_head="" vr_new_body="" vr_pending_reason="" vr_rewrite=0
+	local repo="" evidence="" login="" pr_json="" decision="" hold_action="" hold_reason="" hold_line=""
+
+	_verify_runtime_parse_args "$@" || return 1
+	if ! _verify_runtime_session_is_interactive; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime is restricted to interactive maintainer sessions; workers hand runtime-pending PRs off with POST_PR_HANDOFF"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	repo=$(_merge_resolve_repo "$vr_repo") || return 1
+	evidence=$(_verify_runtime_normalize_evidence "$vr_evidence") || return 1
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- authenticated write permission, never
+	# login text, authorizes a verifier; any author's PR is then eligible.
+	if ! declare -F _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
+		! _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write "$repo"; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime requires write, maintain or admin permission on ${repo} (${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_REASON:-unknown})"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	login="${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_USER:-}"
+	[[ -n "$login" ]] || { print_error "Could not resolve the verifier login"; return 1; }
+
+	pr_json=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" \
+		--json state,isCrossRepository,headRefOid,author,body,labels,closingIssuesReferences) || {
+		print_error "Could not read PR #${vr_pr} in ${repo}"
+		return 1
+	}
+	_verify_runtime_prepare "$repo" "$pr_json" "$evidence" "$login" || return 1
+
+	decision=$(_verify_runtime_hold_decision "$vr_pr" "$repo" "$pr_json") || return 1
+	hold_action="${decision%%$'\t'*}"
+	[[ "$decision" == *$'\t'* ]] && hold_reason="${decision#*$'\t'}"
+	case "$hold_action" in
+	lift) hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} removed (recorded scope: runtime-pending only)" ;;
+	absent) hold_line="no ${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} label present" ;;
+	*)
+		hold_action="keep"
+		hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} kept: ${hold_reason:-scope not verified}"
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	if [[ "$vr_dry_run" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		print_info "Dry run for PR #${vr_pr} at head ${vr_head:0:12}, verifier @${login}"
+		if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+			printf -- '- **Verification:** runtime-pending — %s\n+ %s\n' "$vr_pending_reason" \
+				"$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body |
+					jq -r '"- **Verification:** " + .level + " — " + .evidence')"
+		fi
+		printf 'VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=%s (%s)\n' "$hold_action" "$hold_line"
+		return 0
+	fi
+
+	if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_write_body "$repo" "$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')" || return 1
body:
@coderabbitai Took the second option: the behaviour is kept and the amended contract is documented. `workflows/full-loop.md` and the command help now state that a kept hold still records the evidence. The PR Decisions section records the deviation from the brief. Test: "kept hold still records the runtime evidence". The hold is never lifted outside the runtime-only scope, so the maintainer reviewing the PR-only scope does not repeat the runtime check.

Fixed at head `1a899ae861` (live-verified on this PR with `verify-runtime`; stub suite 45/45).

+#!/usr/bin/env bash

+# A runtime-pending PR (GH#39558) opens under hold-for-review because its runner
+# could not exercise the change. Rerunning commit-and-pr only continues a PR for
+# its author, so a maintainer verifying a worker PR had no supported route.
+# `verify-runtime` records runtime-verified evidence bound to the exact PR head
+# and lifts hold-for-review only when the recorded hold scope is runtime-pending
+# alone. The hold-scope marker is written by _apply_pr_only_hold.

+# Usage: source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/full-loop-helper-verify-runtime.sh"

+#   - full-loop-helper-risk.sh (_runtime_testing_metadata_from_body,

+#
+# Part of aidevops framework: https://aidevops.sh
+
+# Apply strict mode only when executed directly (not when sourced)
+[[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]] && set -euo pipefail

+# Include guard
+[[ -n "${_FULL_LOOP_VERIFY_RUNTIME_LIB_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0

+_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_SCOPE_PREFIX="<!-- aidevops:hold-scope scopes="

+# --- Hold-scope marker ---

+# Print the scope tokens of the newest hold-scope marker whose author holds

+
+# Record why hold-for-review was applied so a verifier can tell which holds it
+# may lift. Tokens: comma-separated subset of pr-only,runtime-pending.
+_record_hold_scope_marker() {
+	local pr_number="$1"
+	local repo="$2"
+	local tokens="$3"

+		return 0

+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	cat >"$body_file" <<EOF
+<!-- ops:start — workers: skip this comment, it is audit trail not implementation context -->
+${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_SCOPE_PREFIX}${tokens} -->
+\`${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL}\` scope: \`${tokens}\`. When \`${_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE}\` is the only scope, a verifier lifts the hold with \`full-loop-helper.sh verify-runtime ${pr_number} ${repo} --testing "<evidence>"\` from the exact PR head.

+
+# --- verify-runtime ---

+_verify_runtime_usage() {

+}
+
+#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- the verifier is a person or session that
+# exercised the change; workers and CI never certify runtime evidence here.
+_verify_runtime_session_is_interactive() {
+	local on="${_FULL_LOOP_TRUE:-true}"
+	if [[ "${HEADLESS:-false}" == "$on" || "${FULL_LOOP_HEADLESS:-}" == "$on" ||
+		"${AIDEVOPS_HEADLESS:-}" == "$on" || "${OPENCODE_HEADLESS:-}" == "$on" ||

+
+# Normalize free-text evidence the way commit-and-pr does and reject text that
+# would change how the body parses or what it closes. Prints trimmed evidence.
+_verify_runtime_normalize_evidence() {
+	local evidence="$1"
+	evidence=$(printf '%s' "$evidence" | sed -E 's/^-[[:space:]]+\*\*([^*]*)\*\*/- \1/') || return 1
+	evidence="${evidence#"${evidence%%[![:space:]]*}"}"

+		print_error "Runtime evidence must not contain a closing keyword reference (it would link an issue for closing)"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! _runtime_evidence_is_substantive "$evidence"; then
+		print_error "Runtime evidence must describe what was exercised and observed; a bare marker or placeholder is not evidence"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	printf '%s\n' "$evidence"

+}
+
+# Rewrite the single generated runtime-pending Verification line. Body on stdin,
+# final evidence in VR_EVIDENCE. Exits 3 unless exactly one such line exists.
+_verify_runtime_rewrite_body() {
+	PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python3 -c '
+import os, re, sys
+body = sys.stdin.read()
+evidence = os.environ["VR_EVIDENCE"]
+if len(re.findall(r"^## Runtime Testing[ \t]*$", body, re.M)) != 1:
+    sys.exit(3)
+section = re.search(r"^## Runtime Testing\s*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", body, re.M | re.S)
+start, end = section.span(1)
+text = body[start:end]
+pattern = re.compile(r"^- \*\*Verification:\*\*[ \t]+runtime-pending[ \t]+—[ \t]*(.*?)"
+                     r"(?=^- \*\*|^(?:Resolves|Fixes|Closes|For|Ref) #\d+\b|^<!-- aidevops:|\Z)", re.M | re.S)
+matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
+if len(matches) != 1:
+    sys.exit(3)
+m = matches[0]
+span = m.group(0)
+trailing = span[len(span.rstrip()):] or "\n"
+line = "- **Verification:** runtime-verified — " + evidence + trailing
+sys.stdout.write(body[:start] + text[:m.start()] + line + text[m.end():] + body[end:])
+'
+	return $?
+}
+
+# Decide whether hold-for-review may be lifted. Prints "lift" or "keep\t<why>".
+_verify_runtime_hold_decision() {
+	local pr_number="$1"
+	local repo="$2"
+	local pr_json="$3"
+	local issues="" issue="" state_rc=0 scopes="" scope_rc=0 body=""
+	if ! printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -e --arg l "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL" 'any(.labels[]?; .name == $l)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+		printf 'absent\n'
+		return 0
+	fi
+	scopes=$(_latest_trusted_hold_scope "$pr_number" "$repo") || scope_rc=$?
+	case "$scope_rc" in
+	0) ;;
+	1)
+		printf 'keep\tthe hold scope was never recorded (PR predates GH#39639 or the hold was added by hand); a maintainer removes %s after review\n' "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope could not be read\n'
+		return 0
+		;;
+	esac
+	if [[ "$scopes" != "$_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE" ]]; then
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope is %s, not runtime-pending alone\n' "$scopes"
+		return 0
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#34052 -- a trusted PR-only contract on any linked
+	# issue keeps the hold even when the marker says runtime-pending.
+	issues=$(_merge_linked_issue_numbers "$pr_number" "$repo" "$pr_json") || {
+		printf 'keep\tlinked issues could not be verified\n'
+		return 0
+	}
+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	issues=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$issues" "$(printf '%s' "$body" |
+		grep -oiE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(for|ref)[[:space:]]+#[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' || true)" |
+		grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | sort -u || true)
+	while IFS= read -r issue; do
+		[[ -n "$issue" ]] || continue
+		state_rc=0
+		_issue_pr_only_contract_state "$issue" "$repo" || state_rc=$?
+		case "$state_rc" in
+		0)
+			printf 'keep\tissue #%s has a trusted PR-only completion contract\n' "$issue"
+			return 0
+			;;
+		1) ;;
+		*)
+			printf 'keep\tPR-only scope for issue #%s could not be verified\n' "$issue"
+			return 0
+			;;
+		esac
+	done <<<"$issues"
+	printf 'lift\n'
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_parse_args() {
+	local -a args=("$@")
+	local index=0 arg="" value=""
+	while [[ "$index" -lt "${#args[@]}" ]]; do
+		arg="${args[$index]}"
+		value=""
+		if [[ "$arg" == "--testing" || "$arg" == "--repo" ]]; then
+			if [[ $((index + 1)) -ge ${#args[@]} ]]; then
+				print_error "${arg} requires a value"
+				return 1
+			fi
+			value="${args[$((index + 1))]}"
+		fi
+		case "$arg" in
+		--testing)
+			vr_evidence="$value"
+			index=$((index + 2))
+			;;
+		--repo)
+			vr_repo="$value"
+			index=$((index + 2))
+			;;
+		--dry-run)
+			vr_dry_run=1
+			index=$((index + 1))
+			;;
+		-*)
+			print_error "Unknown verify-runtime option: $arg"
+			_verify_runtime_usage
+			return 1
+			;;
+		*)
+			if [[ -z "$vr_pr" ]]; then
+				vr_pr="$arg"
+			elif [[ -z "$vr_repo" ]]; then
+				vr_repo="$arg"
+			else
+				_verify_runtime_usage
+				return 1
+			fi
+			index=$((index + 1))
+			;;
+		esac
+	done
+	if [[ ! "$vr_pr" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ || -z "$vr_evidence" ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_usage
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Validate the PR, checkout and body before any write. Sets vr_head,
+# vr_new_body, vr_pending_reason and vr_rewrite in the caller's scope.
+_verify_runtime_prepare() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local pr_json="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local login="$4"
+	local state="" cross="" local_head="" body="" metadata="" level="" sections="" risk=""
+	local final_evidence="" new_metadata="" refusal="" parsed_evidence=""
+
+	state=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.state // ""')
+	# tostring, not `// "unknown"`: jq's alternative operator treats false as absent.
+	cross=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.isCrossRepository | tostring')
+	vr_head=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.headRefOid // ""')
+	if [[ "$state" != "OPEN" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is ${state:-unreadable}; verify-runtime only records evidence on an open PR"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$cross" != "false" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head is not in ${repo}; fork heads are verified by re-publishing from a same-repo branch"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- evidence binds to the exact tested head.
+	local_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || local_head=""
+	if [[ ! "$vr_head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$local_head" != "$vr_head" ]]; then
+		print_error "Local HEAD (${local_head:-none}) is not PR #${vr_pr} head (${vr_head:-unknown}); check out the exact PR head, exercise it, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then
+		print_error "The checkout has uncommitted tracked changes, so the exercised tree is not the PR head; stash or commit them, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi
+
+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	metadata=$(printf '%s' "$body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	level=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')
+	sections=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.sections // 0')
+	risk=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')
+	vr_pending_reason=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')
+	if [[ "$sections" != "1" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has ${sections} Runtime Testing sections; verify-runtime needs exactly the one generated section"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	vr_rewrite=1
+	# shellcheck disable=SC2154 # initialized by full-loop-helper-risk.sh
+	case "$level" in
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_pending_marker") ;;
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker")
+		vr_rewrite=0
+		vr_new_body="$body"
+		print_info "PR #${vr_pr} body is already ${_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker}; leaving its evidence unchanged"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is not runtime-pending (verification level: ${level:-none}); nothing to verify"
+		return 1
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	final_evidence="${evidence} (verified at head ${vr_head:0:12} by @${login})"
+	vr_new_body=$(printf '%s' "$body" | VR_EVIDENCE="$final_evidence" _verify_runtime_rewrite_body) || {
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has no single generated runtime-pending Verification line to rewrite"
+		return 1
+	}
+	# Re-parse with the merge-time parser: the rewritten body must be accepted
+	# by the same recheck merge runs, keep its risk, and carry the evidence whole.
+	new_metadata=$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	parsed_evidence=$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')
+	if [[ "$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')" != "$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker" ||
+		"$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')" != "$risk" ||
+		"$parsed_evidence" != "$final_evidence" ]]; then
+		print_error "The rewritten body does not parse back to the supplied evidence; remove markdown headings, bullets or markers from --testing"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! refusal=$(_runtime_testing_merge_refusal "$new_metadata"); then
+		print_error "The rewritten body would still be refused at merge: ${refusal}"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Write the body and verify it landed on the same head. A head that moved
+# during the edit invalidates the evidence: restore the original body.
+_verify_runtime_write_body() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local original_body="$2"
+	local body_file="" after_json="" after_head="" after_level="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	printf '%s\n' "$vr_new_body" >"$body_file"
+	gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?
+	rm -f "$body_file"
+	if [[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
+		print_error "Could not update PR #${vr_pr} body; nothing else was changed"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	after_json=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --json headRefOid,body) || after_json=""
+	after_head=$(printf '%s' "$after_json" | jq -r '.headRefOid // ""' 2>/dev/null) || after_head=""
+	after_level=$(printf '%s' "$after_json" | jq -r '.body // ""' 2>/dev/null |
+		_runtime_testing_metadata_from_body | jq -r '.level // ""' 2>/dev/null) || after_level=""
+	if [[ "$after_head" != "$vr_head" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head moved during verification (${vr_head:0:12} -> ${after_head:-unknown}); restoring the runtime-pending body"
+		body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+		printf '%s\n' "$original_body" >"$body_file"
+		gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null ||
+			print_error "Restore failed: PR #${vr_pr} body claims evidence for a superseded head; set its Verification line back to runtime-pending"
+		rm -f "$body_file"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$after_level" != "$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body did not reach the ${_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker} postcondition; rerun verify-runtime"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_lift_hold() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local labels=""
+	if ! gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --remove-label "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL" >/dev/null; then
+		print_error "Could not remove ${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} from PR #${vr_pr}; the body is verified, so rerunning verify-runtime retries the label only"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	labels=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --json labels --jq '[.labels[].name] | join(",")') || labels="unreadable"
+	if [[ ",${labels}," == *",${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL},"* || "$labels" == "unreadable" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} did not reach the label-removed postcondition; rerun verify-runtime"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+_verify_runtime_audit_comment() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local login="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local hold_line="$4"
+	local body_file="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	cat >"$body_file" <<EOF
+<!-- ops:start — workers: skip this comment, it is audit trail not implementation context -->
+<!-- aidevops:verify-runtime head=${vr_head} -->
+**Runtime verified** by @${login} at head \`${vr_head}\` (\`full-loop-helper.sh verify-runtime\`, GH#39639).
+
+- Evidence: ${evidence}
+- Previous runtime-pending reason: ${vr_pending_reason:-not recorded}
+- Hold: ${hold_line}
+<!-- ops:end -->
+EOF
+	gh_pr_comment "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?
+	rm -f "$body_file"
+	return "$rc"
+}
+
+# verify-runtime <PR> [REPO] --testing "<evidence>" [--repo R] [--dry-run]
+# Exit 0 on recorded evidence (VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=lifted|kept|absent on
+# stdout); 1 on refusal or failed write. Every refusal precedes every write.
+cmd_verify_runtime() {
+	local vr_pr="" vr_repo="" vr_evidence="" vr_dry_run=0
+	local vr_head="" vr_new_body="" vr_pending_reason="" vr_rewrite=0
+	local repo="" evidence="" login="" pr_json="" decision="" hold_action="" hold_reason="" hold_line=""
+
+	_verify_runtime_parse_args "$@" || return 1
+	if ! _verify_runtime_session_is_interactive; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime is restricted to interactive maintainer sessions; workers hand runtime-pending PRs off with POST_PR_HANDOFF"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	repo=$(_merge_resolve_repo "$vr_repo") || return 1
+	evidence=$(_verify_runtime_normalize_evidence "$vr_evidence") || return 1
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- authenticated write permission, never
+	# login text, authorizes a verifier; any author's PR is then eligible.
+	if ! declare -F _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
+		! _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write "$repo"; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime requires write, maintain or admin permission on ${repo} (${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_REASON:-unknown})"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	login="${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_USER:-}"
+	[[ -n "$login" ]] || { print_error "Could not resolve the verifier login"; return 1; }
+
+	pr_json=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" \
+		--json state,isCrossRepository,headRefOid,author,body,labels,closingIssuesReferences) || {
+		print_error "Could not read PR #${vr_pr} in ${repo}"
+		return 1
+	}
+	_verify_runtime_prepare "$repo" "$pr_json" "$evidence" "$login" || return 1
+
+	decision=$(_verify_runtime_hold_decision "$vr_pr" "$repo" "$pr_json") || return 1
+	hold_action="${decision%%$'\t'*}"
+	[[ "$decision" == *$'\t'* ]] && hold_reason="${decision#*$'\t'}"
+	case "$hold_action" in
+	lift) hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} removed (recorded scope: runtime-pending only)" ;;
+	absent) hold_line="no ${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} label present" ;;
+	*)
+		hold_action="keep"
+		hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} kept: ${hold_reason:-scope not verified}"
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	if [[ "$vr_dry_run" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		print_info "Dry run for PR #${vr_pr} at head ${vr_head:0:12}, verifier @${login}"
+		if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+			printf -- '- **Verification:** runtime-pending — %s\n+ %s\n' "$vr_pending_reason" \
+				"$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body |
+					jq -r '"- **Verification:** " + .level + " — " + .evidence')"
+		fi
+		printf 'VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=%s (%s)\n' "$hold_action" "$hold_line"
+		return 0
+	fi
+
+	if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_write_body "$repo" "$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')" || return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$hold_action" == "lift" ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_lift_hold "$repo" || return 1

@coderabbitai Fixed. `_verify_runtime_lift_hold` re-reads the PR (cache bypassed), requires its head to equal the verified head, and reruns the hold decision before removing the label. After removal it reads the head again. If the head moved, it reapplies `hold-for-review` and re-records the runtime-pending scope. The function comment notes that the removal call itself is not head-conditional. Test: "head moved at label removal reapplies and re-records the hold".

Fixed at head `1a899ae861` (live-verified on this PR with `verify-runtime`; stub suite 45/45).

+#!/usr/bin/env bash

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025-2026 Marcus Quinn

+# Full-Loop Verify Runtime -- verifier route for runtime-pending PRs (GH#39639)
+# =============================================================================
+# A runtime-pending PR (GH#39558) opens under hold-for-review because its runner
+# could not exercise the change. Rerunning commit-and-pr only continues a PR for
+# its author, so a maintainer verifying a worker PR had no supported route.
+# `verify-runtime` records runtime-verified evidence bound to the exact PR head
+# and lifts hold-for-review only when the recorded hold scope is runtime-pending
+# alone. The hold-scope marker is written by _apply_pr_only_hold.
+#
+# Usage: source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/full-loop-helper-verify-runtime.sh"
+#
+# Dependencies:
+#   - shared-constants.sh (print_*, detect_session_origin, gh_pr_edit_safe,
+#     gh_pr_comment, _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write,
+#     _gh_actor_has_repo_write_authority)
+#   - full-loop-helper-risk.sh (_runtime_testing_metadata_from_body,
+#     _runtime_testing_merge_refusal, _runtime_evidence_is_substantive,
+#     _pr_body_inputs_reserve_runtime_section)
+#   - full-loop-helper-merge.sh (_flm_gh_read, _merge_resolve_repo,
+#     _merge_linked_issue_numbers, _issue_pr_only_contract_state)
+#
+# Part of aidevops framework: https://aidevops.sh
+
+# Apply strict mode only when executed directly (not when sourced)
+[[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]] && set -euo pipefail
+
+# Include guard
+[[ -n "${_FULL_LOOP_VERIFY_RUNTIME_LIB_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0
+_FULL_LOOP_VERIFY_RUNTIME_LIB_LOADED=1
+
+_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_SCOPE_PREFIX="<!-- aidevops:hold-scope scopes="
+_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL="hold-for-review"
+_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE="runtime-pending"
+
+# --- Hold-scope marker ---
+
+# Print the scope tokens of the newest hold-scope marker whose author holds
+# repository write authority. Returns 0 found, 1 none recorded, 2 lookup failed.
+_latest_trusted_hold_scope() {
+	local pr_number="$1"
+	local repo="$2"
+	local comments="" markers="" association="" login="" scopes="" authority_rc=0
+	comments=$(_flm_gh_read gh api "repos/${repo}/issues/${pr_number}/comments" --paginate) || return 2
+	markers=$(printf '%s' "$comments" | jq -rs --arg prefix "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_SCOPE_PREFIX" '
+		flatten
+		| map(select(type == "object" and ((.body // "") | contains($prefix))))
+		| sort_by(.created_at) | reverse | .[]
+		| ((.body | capture("<!-- aidevops:hold-scope scopes=(?<s>[a-z,-]+) -->").s) // "") as $s
+		| select($s != "")

+	[[ -n "$markers" ]] || return 1

+	# describes a hold; a forged marker must not turn a manual hold into a
+	# liftable one. An unresolvable newer author fails closed instead of falling
+	# back to an older marker.
+	while IFS=$'\t' read -r association login scopes <&3; do
+		authority_rc=0

+		case "$authority_rc" in
+		0)
+			printf '%s\n' "$scopes"
+			return 0
+			;;
+		1) ;;
+		*) return 2 ;;
+		esac
+	done 3<<<"$markers"
+	return 1

+# Record why hold-for-review was applied so a verifier can tell which holds it
+# may lift. Tokens: comma-separated subset of pr-only,runtime-pending.
+_record_hold_scope_marker() {
+	local pr_number="$1"
+	local repo="$2"
+	local tokens="$3"
+	local existing="" existing_rc=0 body_file="" rc=0
+	[[ "$tokens" =~ ^[a-z-]+(,[a-z-]+)*$ ]] || return 1
+	existing=$(_latest_trusted_hold_scope "$pr_number" "$repo") || existing_rc=$?
+	if [[ "$existing_rc" -eq 0 && "$existing" == "$tokens" ]]; then
+		return 0
+	fi
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1

+${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_SCOPE_PREFIX}${tokens} -->
+\`${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL}\` scope: \`${tokens}\`. When \`${_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE}\` is the only scope, a verifier lifts the hold with \`full-loop-helper.sh verify-runtime ${pr_number} ${repo} --testing "<evidence>"\` from the exact PR head.

+# --- verify-runtime ---

+_verify_runtime_usage() {

+	return 0

+# exercised the change; workers and CI never certify runtime evidence here.
+_verify_runtime_session_is_interactive() {

+		return 1
+	fi
+	declare -F detect_session_origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
+	[[ "$(detect_session_origin)" == "interactive" ]] || return 1
+	return 0

+# Normalize free-text evidence the way commit-and-pr does and reject text that
+# would change how the body parses or what it closes. Prints trimmed evidence.
+_verify_runtime_normalize_evidence() {
+	local evidence="$1"
+	evidence=$(printf '%s' "$evidence" | sed -E 's/^-[[:space:]]+\*\*([^*]*)\*\*/- \1/') || return 1
+	evidence="${evidence#"${evidence%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
+	evidence="${evidence%"${evidence##*[![:space:]]}"}"

+		print_error "Runtime evidence must not contain a closing keyword reference (it would link an issue for closing)"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! _runtime_evidence_is_substantive "$evidence"; then
+		print_error "Runtime evidence must describe what was exercised and observed; a bare marker or placeholder is not evidence"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	printf '%s\n' "$evidence"
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Rewrite the single generated runtime-pending Verification line. Body on stdin,
+# final evidence in VR_EVIDENCE. Exits 3 unless exactly one such line exists.
+_verify_runtime_rewrite_body() {
+	PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python3 -c '
+import os, re, sys
+body = sys.stdin.read()
+evidence = os.environ["VR_EVIDENCE"]
+if len(re.findall(r"^## Runtime Testing[ \t]*$", body, re.M)) != 1:
+    sys.exit(3)
+section = re.search(r"^## Runtime Testing\s*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", body, re.M | re.S)
+start, end = section.span(1)
+text = body[start:end]
+pattern = re.compile(r"^- \*\*Verification:\*\*[ \t]+runtime-pending[ \t]+—[ \t]*(.*?)"
+                     r"(?=^- \*\*|^(?:Resolves|Fixes|Closes|For|Ref) #\d+\b|^<!-- aidevops:|\Z)", re.M | re.S)
+matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
+if len(matches) != 1:
+    sys.exit(3)
+m = matches[0]
+span = m.group(0)
+trailing = span[len(span.rstrip()):] or "\n"
+line = "- **Verification:** runtime-verified — " + evidence + trailing
+sys.stdout.write(body[:start] + text[:m.start()] + line + text[m.end():] + body[end:])
+'
+	return $?
+}

+# Decide whether hold-for-review may be lifted. Prints "lift" or "keep\t<why>".
+_verify_runtime_hold_decision() {

+	local repo="$2"
+	local pr_json="$3"

+		printf 'absent\n'
+		return 0
+	fi
+	scopes=$(_latest_trusted_hold_scope "$pr_number" "$repo") || scope_rc=$?

+	0) ;;
+	1)
+		printf 'keep\tthe hold scope was never recorded (PR predates GH#39639 or the hold was added by hand); a maintainer removes %s after review\n' "$_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope could not be read\n'
+		return 0
+		;;
+	esac
+	if [[ "$scopes" != "$_FULL_LOOP_RUNTIME_PENDING_SCOPE" ]]; then
+		printf 'keep\tthe recorded hold scope is %s, not runtime-pending alone\n' "$scopes"
+		return 0
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#34052 -- a trusted PR-only contract on any linked
+	# issue keeps the hold even when the marker says runtime-pending.
+	issues=$(_merge_linked_issue_numbers "$pr_number" "$repo" "$pr_json") || {
+		printf 'keep\tlinked issues could not be verified\n'
+		return 0
+	}
+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')

+		0)

+		1) ;;
+		*)

+			return 0

+		esac

+	return 0

+_verify_runtime_parse_args() {

+	fi

+# Validate the PR, checkout and body before any write. Sets vr_head,

+	local repo="$1"
+	local pr_json="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local login="$4"
+	local state="" cross="" local_head="" body="" metadata="" level="" sections="" risk=""

+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is ${state:-unreadable}; verify-runtime only records evidence on an open PR"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if [[ "$cross" != "false" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head is not in ${repo}; fork heads are verified by re-publishing from a same-repo branch"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- evidence binds to the exact tested head.
+	local_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || local_head=""
+	if [[ ! "$vr_head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$local_head" != "$vr_head" ]]; then
+		print_error "Local HEAD (${local_head:-none}) is not PR #${vr_pr} head (${vr_head:-unknown}); check out the exact PR head, exercise it, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then
+		print_error "The checkout has uncommitted tracked changes, so the exercised tree is not the PR head; stash or commit them, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi

+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	metadata=$(printf '%s' "$body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	level=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')
+	sections=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.sections // 0')
+	risk=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')
+	vr_pending_reason=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')
+	if [[ "$sections" != "1" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has ${sections} Runtime Testing sections; verify-runtime needs exactly the one generated section"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	vr_rewrite=1
+	# shellcheck disable=SC2154 # initialized by full-loop-helper-risk.sh
+	case "$level" in
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_pending_marker") ;;
+	"$_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker")
+		vr_rewrite=0
+		vr_new_body="$body"
+		print_info "PR #${vr_pr} body is already ${_full_loop_runtime_verified_marker}; leaving its evidence unchanged"
+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is not runtime-pending (verification level: ${level:-none}); nothing to verify"
+		return 1
+		;;
+	esac

+	final_evidence="${evidence} (verified at head ${vr_head:0:12} by @${login})"
+	vr_new_body=$(printf '%s' "$body" | VR_EVIDENCE="$final_evidence" _verify_runtime_rewrite_body) || {
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has no single generated runtime-pending Verification line to rewrite"
+		return 1
+	}

+	# by the same recheck merge runs, keep its risk, and carry the evidence whole.
+	new_metadata=$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	parsed_evidence=$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')

+		"$(printf '%s' "$new_metadata" | jq -r '.risk // ""')" != "$risk" ||
+		"$parsed_evidence" != "$final_evidence" ]]; then
+		print_error "The rewritten body does not parse back to the supplied evidence; remove markdown headings, bullets or markers from --testing"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! refusal=$(_runtime_testing_merge_refusal "$new_metadata"); then
+		print_error "The rewritten body would still be refused at merge: ${refusal}"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	return 0
+}
+
+# Write the body and verify it landed on the same head. A head that moved
+# during the edit invalidates the evidence: restore the original body.
+_verify_runtime_write_body() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local original_body="$2"
+	local body_file="" after_json="" after_head="" after_level="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	printf '%s\n' "$vr_new_body" >"$body_file"
+	gh_pr_edit_safe "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?

+		return 1

+	if [[ "$cross" != "false" ]]; then
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} head is not in ${repo}; fork heads are verified by re-publishing from a same-repo branch"
+		return 1
+	fi

+		return 1
+	fi
+	if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then
+		print_error "The checkout has uncommitted tracked changes, so the exercised tree is not the PR head; stash or commit them, then rerun"
+		return 1
+	fi

+	body=$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')
+	metadata=$(printf '%s' "$body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body) || return 1
+	level=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.level // ""')
+	sections=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.sections // 0')

+	vr_pending_reason=$(printf '%s' "$metadata" | jq -r '.evidence // ""')

+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} body has ${sections} Runtime Testing sections; verify-runtime needs exactly the one generated section"
+		return 1

+		return 0
+		;;
+	*)
+		print_error "PR #${vr_pr} is not runtime-pending (verification level: ${level:-none}); nothing to verify"
+		return 1
+		;;

+# Write the body and verify it landed on the same head. A head that moved

+	local original_body="$2"

+	printf '%s\n' "$vr_new_body" >"$body_file"

+		print_error "Could not update PR #${vr_pr} body; nothing else was changed"
+		return 1

+		return 1
+	fi

+_verify_runtime_audit_comment() {
+	local repo="$1"
+	local login="$2"
+	local evidence="$3"
+	local hold_line="$4"
+	local body_file="" rc=0
+	body_file=$(mktemp) || return 1
+	cat >"$body_file" <<EOF
+<!-- ops:start — workers: skip this comment, it is audit trail not implementation context -->
+<!-- aidevops:verify-runtime head=${vr_head} -->
+**Runtime verified** by @${login} at head \`${vr_head}\` (\`full-loop-helper.sh verify-runtime\`, GH#39639).
+
+- Evidence: ${evidence}
+- Previous runtime-pending reason: ${vr_pending_reason:-not recorded}
+- Hold: ${hold_line}
+<!-- ops:end -->
+EOF
+	gh_pr_comment "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" --body-file "$body_file" >/dev/null || rc=$?
+	rm -f "$body_file"
+	return "$rc"

+# verify-runtime <PR> [REPO] --testing "<evidence>" [--repo R] [--dry-run]
+# Exit 0 on recorded evidence (VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=lifted|kept|absent on
+# stdout); 1 on refusal or failed write. Every refusal precedes every write.
+cmd_verify_runtime() {
+	local vr_pr="" vr_repo="" vr_evidence="" vr_dry_run=0
+	local vr_head="" vr_new_body="" vr_pending_reason="" vr_rewrite=0
+	local repo="" evidence="" login="" pr_json="" decision="" hold_action="" hold_reason="" hold_line=""

+	_verify_runtime_parse_args "$@" || return 1
+	if ! _verify_runtime_session_is_interactive; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime is restricted to interactive maintainer sessions; workers hand runtime-pending PRs off with POST_PR_HANDOFF"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	repo=$(_merge_resolve_repo "$vr_repo") || return 1
+	evidence=$(_verify_runtime_normalize_evidence "$vr_evidence") || return 1
+	#aidevops:trust-boundary GH#39639 -- authenticated write permission, never
+	# login text, authorizes a verifier; any author's PR is then eligible.
+	if ! declare -F _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
+		! _gh_current_user_allows_repo_write "$repo"; then
+		print_error "verify-runtime requires write, maintain or admin permission on ${repo} (${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_REASON:-unknown})"
+		return 1
+	fi
+	login="${AIDEVOPS_GH_WRITE_PERMISSION_USER:-}"
+	[[ -n "$login" ]] || { print_error "Could not resolve the verifier login"; return 1; }
+
+	pr_json=$(_flm_gh_read gh pr view "$vr_pr" --repo "$repo" \
+		--json state,isCrossRepository,headRefOid,author,body,labels,closingIssuesReferences) || {
+		print_error "Could not read PR #${vr_pr} in ${repo}"
+		return 1
+	}
+	_verify_runtime_prepare "$repo" "$pr_json" "$evidence" "$login" || return 1
+
+	decision=$(_verify_runtime_hold_decision "$vr_pr" "$repo" "$pr_json") || return 1
+	hold_action="${decision%%$'\t'*}"
+	[[ "$decision" == *$'\t'* ]] && hold_reason="${decision#*$'\t'}"
+	case "$hold_action" in
+	lift) hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} removed (recorded scope: runtime-pending only)" ;;
+	absent) hold_line="no ${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} label present" ;;
+	*)
+		hold_action="keep"
+		hold_line="${_FULL_LOOP_HOLD_LABEL} kept: ${hold_reason:-scope not verified}"
+		;;
+	esac
+
+	if [[ "$vr_dry_run" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		print_info "Dry run for PR #${vr_pr} at head ${vr_head:0:12}, verifier @${login}"
+		if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+			printf -- '- **Verification:** runtime-pending — %s\n+ %s\n' "$vr_pending_reason" \
+				"$(printf '%s' "$vr_new_body" | _runtime_testing_metadata_from_body |
+					jq -r '"- **Verification:** " + .level + " — " + .evidence')"
+		fi
+		printf 'VERIFY_RUNTIME_HOLD=%s (%s)\n' "$hold_action" "$hold_line"
+		return 0
+	fi
+
+	if [[ "$vr_rewrite" -eq 1 ]]; then
+		_verify_runtime_write_body "$repo" "$(printf '%s' "$pr_json" | jq -r '.body // ""')" || return 1

+# A runtime-pending PR opens under hold-for-review because its runner could not

+# lets an interactive session verify it, but nothing told a verifier a PR was

+# from there (`_pm_gate_origin_authority`) and:

+#      liftable (trusted runtime-pending-only scope, no PR-only contract). The
+#      trust logic stays in that helper and is never copied here;
+#   2. sends one session-bus notice per `<repo>#<PR>@<head>` to the live
+#      interactive sessions on that repository;
+#   3. with no such session, logs an ATTENTION line (PR, age, reason), the

+# Headless verifiers and removing the hold are out of scope.

+_PMRP_SESSION_BUS_HELPER="${PULSE_RUNTIME_PENDING_SESSION_BUS_HELPER:-${_pmrp_script_dir}/session-bus-helper.sh}"

+# once a notice was sent for a head the interval is longer.

+_PMRP_RECHECK_SENT_SECONDS="${PULSE_RUNTIME_PENDING_RECHECK_SENT_SECONDS:-1800}"

+# Print the epoch stored in a state file, or 0.
+_pmrp_read_epoch() {

+	local value=""

+	[[ -f "$sent_file" ]] && sent_head=$(<"$sent_file")

** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Re-read the PR body before the backfill write.** `cmd_ensure_pr_anchor` writes the body it read before `cmd_ensure_anchor` ran. A maintainer edit saved in that interval is overwritten. The edit can drop new instructions or an identity line the maintainer added. `gh_pr_edit_safe` writes the supplied body unconditionally and does not compare it with the current body. After `cmd_ensure_anchor` returns, read the labels and body again. Repeat the `origin:worker` and no-closing-or-explicit-identity checks on the new body. If the body differs from the body read at the start, do not write the earlier body. Return a failure, or rebuild the replacement from the current body. This narrows the window to the gap between the re-read and the edit. It does not remove that gap, because `gh pr edit --body-file` replaces the full body with no conditional check.

** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Journal the marker publication atomically, and let replay complete a missing rebind event.** `rebind_moved_admin` calls `os.replace` inside the write transaction, before `connection.commit()` runs. If the process stops after the replace but before the commit, the marker names the new directory and the `rebind-admin-directory` event is rolled back. A commit failure at the same point leaves the same state. A retry then sees `previous == current` and returns `rebound: False` without journaling. The inline comment says replay repairs a crash, but the early return does not do that. The rebind must satisfy both states. A marker that names the destination must have a committed journal event, and a journal event must not depend on a marker that was never published. Choose a protocol that guarantees this. Replay must also write the missing event when the marker already names the destination path. Fix the comment that claims replay repairs the crash, so it matches the behavior.

+
+Only the marker's `git_directory` path string may differ. Every physical proof
+must still hold: installation, worktree path, both inodes, the registry's
+generation at that path, and Git's own `gitdir` backlink. A copy or restore has
+new inodes (or a stale backlink), so it keeps refusing. The operation is
+journaled, idempotent and never an admission or removal right.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import sqlite3
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4, uuid5
+
+from .admission import AdmissionRegistry
+from .directory_handle import DirectoryHandle
+from .enrollment import MARKER, _directory_inode, _git_directory, _read_marker
+from .storage import LifecycleRegistry, StoreConflict, encode
+
+__all__ = ["rebind_moved_admin"]
+
+MISMATCH = "generation-directory-mismatch"
+
+
+def _replace_marker(directory: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    temporary = directory / f".aidevops-generation-{uuid4()}.tmp"
+    descriptor = os.open(temporary, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            stream.write(encode(value).encode("utf-8"))
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.replace(temporary, directory / MARKER)
+    except BaseException:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        raise
+
+

+    row = connection.execute(

+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None or row["path"] != str(path) or row["state"] not in ("open", "closed"):

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Marcus Quinn
+"""Release retained aidevops-worker-* user units after drained quiescence (GH#39702).
+
+Managed launches keep their transient units (RemainAfterExit=yes) so readers
+can sample a drained invocation. Without this sweep nothing releases them, and
+the user manager keeps one unit per attempt.
+
+A unit is released only when, in the current boot, it is drained by the same
+criteria as drain_unit (matching invocation, MainPID=0, no job, active/exited
+or failed/failed, unpopulated cgroup), and has stayed in that state for longer
+than the grace period. Every registry launch that references it must match the
+invocation. The drained sample is committed to worktree_unit_releases before the
+unit is resampled and stopped. drain_unit accepts that receipt once the unit is
+gone. Lifetime rows are never rewritten, so their equality guards still hold.
+
+Units with processes (including active/running with MainPID=0 strays) are
+never stopped; they are counted and retained. Receipts from earlier boots are
+pruned because ended-boot receipts replace them.
+"""
+

+from contextlib import closing
+import copy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import random
+import re
+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+

+HISTORY = "worktree_lifetime_history"

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Marcus Quinn
+"""Durable release receipts for retained aidevops-worker-* units (GH#39702).
+
+worktree_lifetime_release.py commits a receipt after a drained sample of one
+invocation and before it stops the unit. Stopping destroys the invocation's
+cgroup, so it cannot be repopulated: the recorded sample then stands in for the
+retained unit, like an ended-boot receipt stands in for a previous boot.
+"""
+
+from contextlib import closing
+import json
+import math
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+import time
+
+import worktree_lifetime_owner as owner
+
+RELEASE_TABLE = "worktree_unit_releases"
+RELEASE_SCHEMA = "unit-release/v1"
+UNIT_NAME = re.compile(r"aidevops-worker-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\.service)?")
+READ_ERRORS = (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, sqlite3.Error, subprocess.SubprocessError)
+
+
+def unit_id(unit):
+    """Canonical unit name: Pulse records omit the .service suffix."""
+    return unit if unit.endswith(".service") else unit + ".service"
+

+    directory = Path(os.environ.get("WORKTREE_REGISTRY_DIR") or Path.home() / ".aidevops/.agent-workspace")
+    return Path(os.environ.get("WORKTREE_REGISTRY_DB") or directory / "worktree-registry.db")
+
+
+def connect(db, readonly):
+    owner.require(db.is_file() and not db.is_symlink(), "registry unavailable")
+    uri = db.resolve().as_uri() + ("?mode=ro" if readonly else "?mode=rw")
+    return sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, timeout=10, isolation_level=None)

+  VOICESTUDIO_URL         server base URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3900;

+  VOICESTUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR  where the MCP proxy saves generated audio
+  VOICESTUDIO_TIMEOUT     per-request timeout in seconds (default 600)

+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse
+import base64
+import io

+import re

+import sys

+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+import uuid
+import wave
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEFAULT_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:3900"
+# VoiceStudio abandons a request after about 300 s of GPU time (HTTP 503). On a
+# slow GPU a long sentence gets there, so text is spoken in pieces of this size.
+DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 220
+NATIVE_FORMATS = {"mp3", "opus", "aac", "flac", "wav"}

+    """A request the server refused or could not complete."""

+def base_url() -> str:

+    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"VOICESTUDIO_URL must be an http(s) URL, got {url!r}")
+    return url.rstrip("/")

+    name = os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_SECRET", "OMNIVOICE_API_KEY")
+    return os.environ.get(name, "")
+
+

+    return float(os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_TIMEOUT", "600"))

+def request(method: str, path: str, body: bytes | None = None,
+            headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[int, dict[str, str], bytes]:
+    """Send one request; HTTP errors are returned, not raised."""
+    all_headers = dict(headers or {})
+    key = api_key()
+    if key:
+        all_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {key}"
+    req = urllib.request.Request(base_url() + path, data=body, headers=all_headers, method=method)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout()) as resp:  # nosec B310 -- base_url() allows http(s) only
+            return resp.status, {k.lower(): v for k, v in resp.headers.items()}, resp.read()
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        return exc.code, {k.lower(): v for k, v in exc.headers.items()}, exc.read()
+    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"cannot reach {base_url()}: {exc.reason}") from exc

+def check(status: int, data: bytes, what: str) -> None:

+SENTENCE_END = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?\u2026\u3002\uff01\uff1f])\s+")

+    """Split text into (piece, pause-after-seconds) at paragraph, sentence, then clause breaks."""
+    pieces: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
+    for paragraph in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", text):
+        parts = [clause for sentence in SENTENCE_END.split(" ".join(paragraph.split()))
+                 for clause in _clauses(sentence, limit)]
+        packed = _pack(parts, limit)
+        pieces += [(piece, 0.3) for piece in packed[:-1]] + [(piece, 0.7) for piece in packed[-1:]]
+    return pieces
+

+def _clauses(text: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Break one sentence into clause-sized parts; over-long clauses are cut at spaces."""
+    if len(text) <= limit:
+        return [text] if text else []
+    return [cut for part in CLAUSE_END.split(text) for cut in _hard_wrap(part, limit)]
+

+def _hard_wrap(part: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    out = []
+    while len(part) > limit:
+        cut = part.rfind(" ", 0, limit)
+        cut = cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit
+        out.append(part[:cut].strip())
+        part = part[cut:].strip()
+    return out + [part] if part else out

+def _pack(parts: list[str], limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Greedily join consecutive parts into pieces of at most `limit` characters."""
+    out: list[str] = []
+    for part in filter(None, parts):
+        if out and len(out[-1]) + len(part) + 1 <= limit:
+            out[-1] = f"{out[-1]} {part}"
+        else:
+            out.append(part)
+    return out

+def synth(text: str, opts: argparse.Namespace, fmt: str = "wav") -> bytes:
+    payload = {"model": opts.model, "input": text, "voice": opts.voice,

+    if opts.language:
+        payload["language"] = opts.language
+    if opts.instruct:
+        payload["instruct"] = opts.instruct
+    delay = float(os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_RETRY_DELAY", "30"))
+    for attempt in range(opts.retries + 1):
+        status, _, data = request("POST", "/v1/audio/speech", json.dumps(payload).encode(),
+                                  {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
+        if status < 500 or attempt == opts.retries:
+            break

+        print(f"[voicestudio] HTTP {status}, retrying in {delay * (attempt + 1):.0f}s",
+              file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        time.sleep(delay * (attempt + 1))

+    return data

+def join_wavs(chunks: list[tuple[bytes, float]]) -> bytes:
+    """Concatenate WAV clips with silence; every clip must share one format."""
+    out = io.BytesIO()
+    params = None

+        for index, (clip, pause) in enumerate(chunks):
+            with wave.open(io.BytesIO(clip), "rb") as reader:
+                clip_params = reader.getparams()[:3]
+                if params is None:
+                    params = clip_params
+                    writer.setnchannels(params[0])
+                    writer.setsampwidth(params[1])
+                    writer.setframerate(params[2])
+                elif clip_params != params:
+                    raise VoiceStudioError(f"clip {index} format {clip_params} differs from {params}")
+                writer.writeframes(reader.readframes(reader.getnframes()))
+            if index < len(chunks) - 1 and pause > 0:
+                writer.writeframes(b"\0" * int(params[2] * pause) * params[0] * params[1])
+    return out.getvalue()

+def write_audio(wav: bytes, out: Path) -> None:
+    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if out.suffix.lower() == ".wav":
+        out.write_bytes(wav)
+        return
+    ffmpeg = shutil.which("ffmpeg")
+    if not ffmpeg:
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"ffmpeg is needed to write {out.suffix} from several pieces; use .wav")

+          f"{active.get('effective_device', 'unknown')}, cloning: {active.get('supports_cloning')}")
+    if opts.json:
+        print(json.dumps(engines, indent=2))
+    return 0
+
+
+def cmd_voices(opts: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
+    profiles = get_json("/profiles")
+    if opts.json:
+        print(json.dumps(profiles, indent=2))
+        return 0
+    print("id\tkind\tlanguage\tname")
+    for p in profiles:
+        print(f"{p.get('id')}\t{p.get('kind')}\t{p.get('language') or '-'}\t{p.get('name')}")
+    print("OpenAI names (alloy, nova, ...) and 'default' map to the engine default voice.",
+          file=sys.stderr)
+    return 0
+
+
+def read_text(opts: argparse.Namespace) -> str:
+    if opts.text:
+        return opts.text
+    if opts.file:
+        return Path(opts.file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    if sys.stdin.isatty():
+        raise VoiceStudioError("give --text, --file, or text on stdin")
+    return sys.stdin.read()
+

+def cmd_speak(opts: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
+    text = read_text(opts).strip()

+        raise VoiceStudioError("no text to speak")

+    pieces = split_text(text, opts.max_chars)
+    ext = out.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    if len(pieces) == 1 and ext in NATIVE_FORMATS:
+        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        out.write_bytes(synth(pieces[0][0], opts, ext))
+    else:
+        clips = []
+        for index, (piece, pause) in enumerate(pieces, 1):
+            print(f"[voicestudio] piece {index}/{len(pieces)} ({len(piece)} chars)",
+                  file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

+        write_audio(join_wavs(clips), out)

+    return 0

+def cmd_transcribe(opts: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
+    fields = {"model": "whisper-1", "response_format": opts.format}
+    if opts.language:
+        fields["language"] = opts.language

+    text = json.loads(data).get("text", "") if opts.format == "json" else data.decode("utf-8")

+        Path(opts.out).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

+def output_dir() -> Path:
+    configured = os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR")

+        return Path(configured).expanduser()
+    temp = os.environ.get("AIDEVOPS_TEMP_DIR") or str(Path.home() / ".aidevops/.agent-workspace/tmp")

+    "generate_speech": ("output_path", "Local file to write the WAV to (default: a file under "

+    "clone_voice": ("ref_audio_file", "Local reference audio file (5-30 s, one speaker); "

+    "transcribe": ("audio_file", "Local audio file; the proxy uploads it as audio_base64."),

+class McpProxy:
+    """Bridge MCP stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC) to VoiceStudio's /mcp endpoint."""

+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.session: str | None = None
+        self.init_message: dict | None = None

+        if self.session:
+            headers["Mcp-Session-Id"] = self.session

+                if "result" in reply:

+    def run(self) -> int:

+        for line in sys.stdin:

+            except json.JSONDecodeError:

+                self.handle(message)  # everything else needs the session it creates
+                continue

+            thread.start()
+            threads.append(thread)
+        for thread in threads:
+            thread.join()

** Major** · **Security & Privacy** · **Quick win** **Reject `http://` URLs for non-loopback hosts before sending the bearer key.** `base_url()` accepts any `http://` URL. `request()` then adds `Authorization: Bearer ` whenever a key is set. If `VOICESTUDIO_URL=http://voice.example.net:3900` and a key is stored, the key and all text and audio travel in cleartext. The tool is meant for a shared self-hosted server, so remote hosts are a normal use. Only allow plain `http` for loopback hosts (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Otherwise require `https`, or an explicit opt-in variable such as `VOICESTUDIO_ALLOW_INSECURE=1`. Based on learnings, check that the client rejects or fails a credentialed request before sending it over plain HTTP.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025-2026 Marcus Quinn
+"""HTTP, text-splitting and WAV helpers for voicestudio_client.py (standard library only).
+
+Environment:
+  VOICESTUDIO_URL         server base URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3900;
+                          OMNIVOICE_URL is accepted as a fallback)
+  VOICESTUDIO_SECRET      name of the variable holding the key
+                          (default OMNIVOICE_API_KEY)
+  VOICESTUDIO_TIMEOUT     per-request timeout in seconds (default 600)
+  VOICESTUDIO_RETRY_DELAY seconds before the first 5xx retry (default 30)
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess  # nosec B404 -- ffmpeg conversion only, fixed argv; see write_audio
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+import uuid
+import wave
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEFAULT_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:3900"
+# VoiceStudio abandons a request after about 300 s of GPU time (HTTP 503). On a
+# slow GPU a long sentence gets there, so text is spoken in pieces of this size.
+DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 220
+NATIVE_FORMATS = {"mp3", "opus", "aac", "flac", "wav"}
+SENTENCE_END = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?\u2026\u3002\uff01\uff1f])\s+")
+CLAUSE_END = re.compile(r"(?<=[,;:\u2014\u3001\uff0c\uff1b])\s*")
+
+
+class VoiceStudioError(RuntimeError):
+    """A request the server refused or could not complete."""
+
+
+# ---------- HTTP ----------
+
+
+def base_url() -> str:
+    url = os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_URL") or os.environ.get("OMNIVOICE_URL") or DEFAULT_URL
+    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"VOICESTUDIO_URL must be an http(s) URL, got {url!r}")
+    return url.rstrip("/")
+
+
+def api_key() -> str:
+    name = os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_SECRET", "OMNIVOICE_API_KEY")
+    return os.environ.get(name, "")
+
+
+def request(method: str, path: str, body: bytes | None = None,
+            headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[int, dict[str, str], bytes]:
+    """Send one request; HTTP errors are returned, not raised."""
+    all_headers = dict(headers or {})
+    key = api_key()
+    if key:
+        all_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {key}"
+    req = urllib.request.Request(base_url() + path, data=body, headers=all_headers, method=method)
+    wait = float(os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_TIMEOUT", "600"))
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=wait) as resp:  # nosec B310 -- base_url() allows http(s) only
+            return resp.status, {k.lower(): v for k, v in resp.headers.items()}, resp.read()
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        return exc.code, {k.lower(): v for k, v in exc.headers.items()}, exc.read()
+    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"cannot reach {base_url()}: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+
+def check(status: int, data: bytes, what: str) -> None:
+    if status == 401:
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"{what}: 401 unauthorised - store the key with "
+                               "`aidevops secret set OMNIVOICE_API_KEY`")
+    if status >= 400:
+        detail = data[:300].decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"{what}: HTTP {status} {detail}")
+
+
+def get_json(path: str):
+    status, _, data = request("GET", path)
+    check(status, data, f"GET {path}")
+    return json.loads(data)
+
+
+def post_multipart(path: str, fields: dict[str, str], files: dict[str, Path]) -> bytes:
+    boundary = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    out = io.BytesIO()
+    for name, value in fields.items():
+        out.write(f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"\r\n\r\n'.encode())
+        out.write(str(value).encode() + b"\r\n")
+    for name, file_path in files.items():
+        out.write(f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"; '
+                  f'filename="{file_path.name}"\r\n'
+                  "Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n".encode())
+        out.write(file_path.read_bytes() + b"\r\n")
+    out.write(f"--{boundary}--\r\n".encode())
+    status, _, data = request("POST", path, out.getvalue(),
+                              {"Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}"})
+    check(status, data, f"POST {path}")
+    return data
+
+
+# ---------- text ----------
+
+
+def split_text(text: str, limit: int) -> list[tuple[str, float]]:
+    """Split text into (piece, pause-after-seconds) at paragraph, sentence, then clause breaks."""
+    pieces: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
+    for paragraph in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", text):
+        parts = [clause for sentence in SENTENCE_END.split(" ".join(paragraph.split()))
+                 for clause in _clauses(sentence, limit)]
+        packed = _pack(parts, limit)
+        pieces += [(piece, 0.3) for piece in packed[:-1]] + [(piece, 0.7) for piece in packed[-1:]]
+    return pieces
+
+
+def _clauses(text: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Break one sentence into clause-sized parts; over-long clauses are cut at spaces."""
+    if len(text) <= limit:
+        return [text] if text else []
+    return [cut for part in CLAUSE_END.split(text) for cut in _hard_wrap(part, limit)]
+
+
+def _hard_wrap(part: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    out = []
+    while len(part) > limit:
+        cut = part.rfind(" ", 0, limit)
+        cut = cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit
+        out.append(part[:cut].strip())
+        part = part[cut:].strip()
+    return out + [part] if part else out
+
+
+def _pack(parts: list[str], limit: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Greedily join consecutive parts into pieces of at most `limit` characters."""
+    out: list[str] = []
+    for part in filter(None, parts):
+        if out and len(out[-1]) + len(part) + 1 <= limit:
+            out[-1] = f"{out[-1]} {part}"
+        else:
+            out.append(part)
+    return out
+
+
+# ---------- speech and audio ----------
+
+
+def synth(text: str, opts, fmt: str = "wav") -> bytes:
+    """One /v1/audio/speech request, retried on 5xx (a busy or out-of-memory GPU)."""
+    payload = {"model": opts.model, "input": text, "voice": opts.voice,
+               "response_format": fmt, "speed": opts.speed}
+    payload.update({k: v for k, v in (("language", opts.language), ("instruct", opts.instruct)) if v})
+    delay = float(os.environ.get("VOICESTUDIO_RETRY_DELAY", "30"))
+    for attempt in range(opts.retries + 1):
+        status, _, data = request("POST", "/v1/audio/speech", json.dumps(payload).encode(),
+                                  {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
+        if status < 500 or attempt == opts.retries:
+            break
+        # An abandoned GPU job keeps the device busy until it finishes.
+        print(f"[voicestudio] HTTP {status}, retrying in {delay * (attempt + 1):.0f}s",
+              file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        time.sleep(delay * (attempt + 1))
+    check(status, data, "speech")
+    return data
+
+
+def join_wavs(chunks: list[tuple[bytes, float]]) -> bytes:
+    """Concatenate WAV clips with silence; every clip must share one format."""
+    out = io.BytesIO()
+    params = None
+    with wave.open(out, "wb") as writer:
+        for index, (clip, pause) in enumerate(chunks):
+            with wave.open(io.BytesIO(clip), "rb") as reader:
+                clip_params = reader.getparams()[:3]
+                if params is None:
+                    params = clip_params
+                    writer.setnchannels(params[0])
+                    writer.setsampwidth(params[1])
+                    writer.setframerate(params[2])
+                elif clip_params != params:
+                    raise VoiceStudioError(f"clip {index} format {clip_params} differs from {params}")
+                writer.writeframes(reader.readframes(reader.getnframes()))
+            if index < len(chunks) - 1 and pause > 0:
+                writer.writeframes(b"\0" * int(params[2] * pause) * params[0] * params[1])
+    return out.getvalue()
+
+
+def write_audio(wav: bytes, out: Path) -> None:
+    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if out.suffix.lower() == ".wav":
+        out.write_bytes(wav)
+        return
+    ffmpeg = shutil.which("ffmpeg")
+    if not ffmpeg:
+        raise VoiceStudioError(f"ffmpeg is needed to write {out.suffix} from several pieces; use .wav")
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav") as tmp:
+        tmp.write(wav)
+        tmp.flush()
+        # Absolute output path, so a name starting with "-" is never read as an option.
+        argv = [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", tmp.name, str(out.resolve())]
+        subprocess.run(argv, check=True)  # nosec B603 -- resolved ffmpeg, fixed argv, no shell

** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Handle `ffmpeg` failure as `VoiceStudioError`.** `subprocess.run(..., check=True)` raises `CalledProcessError` when ffmpeg fails. This happens on an unsupported extension or an unwritable path. `main()` catches only `VoiceStudioError`, so the user gets a traceback and exit code 1. All the synthesized audio is lost. Catch `subprocess.CalledProcessError` and `OSError` and re-raise them as `VoiceStudioError`. Consider saving the joined WAV next to the target so the work can be reused. As per path instructions, scripts need "Proper exit codes" and "Error recovery mechanisms".

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025-2026 Marcus Quinn
+"""Local-file rewriting for the VoiceStudio MCP proxy (voicestudio_mcp.py).
+
+Audio never passes through the model's context: generate_speech output is
+written to a file and returned as `audio_path`, and clone_voice / transcribe
+take a local file that the proxy reads and uploads.
+
+Environment: VOICESTUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR (default $AIDEVOPS_TEMP_DIR/voicestudio,
+else ~/.aidevops/.agent-workspace/tmp/voicestudio).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+LOCAL_ARGS = {
+    "generate_speech": ("output_path", "Local file to write the WAV to (default: a file under "
+                        "VOICESTUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR). The proxy returns audio_path instead of base64."),
+    "clone_voice": ("ref_audio_file", "Local reference audio file (5-30 s, one speaker); "
+                    "the proxy uploads it as ref_audio_base64."),
+    "transcribe": ("audio_file", "Local audio file; the proxy uploads it as audio_base64."),
+}
+UPLOAD_TARGET = {"clone_voice": "ref_audio_base64", "transcribe": "audio_base64"}
+
+
+def rewrite_call(message: dict) -> dict:
+    """Replace the proxy's local-file arguments with what the server expects."""
+    message = json.loads(json.dumps(message))
+    params = message.get("params", {})
+    tool = params.get("name")
+    args = params.setdefault("arguments", {})
+    if tool == "generate_speech":
+        args.pop("output_path", None)  # applied when the result comes back
+    elif tool in UPLOAD_TARGET:
+        local = args.pop(LOCAL_ARGS[tool][0], None)
+        if local:
+            args[UPLOAD_TARGET[tool]] = base64.b64encode(Path(local).expanduser().read_bytes()).decode()
+    return message

** Major** · **Security & Privacy** · **Heavy lift** **Restrict local file reads and writes done on behalf of the model.** The MCP tool arguments come from model output. `audio_file` and `ref_audio_file` accept any path, such as `~/.ssh/id_rsa`. `rewrite_call` reads the file and uploads it to the VoiceStudio server. `output_path` accepts any path, and `_write_wav` overwrites it. A prompt-injected agent could therefore exfiltrate files or overwrite files. Confine reads and writes to approved directories. For example, resolve the path and require it to sit under the working directory or `output_dir()`. Reject other paths with a `ValueError`, which `handle()` already turns into a JSON-RPC error. The extra `.wav` suffix check on writes also helps.
Proposed fix

```diff +def _confined(raw: str, roots: list[Path]) -> Path: + path = Path(raw).expanduser().resolve() + if not any(path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) for root in roots): + raise ValueError(f"path outside allowed directories: {path}") + return path ```
